crossRefs.note: For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun?
What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?
This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors…
Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
Why do you spend money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which doesn’t satisfy? Listen diligently to…
Behold, isn’t it of Yahweh of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?
“What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies…
For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange…
For what does it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?
For what will a man give in exchange for his life?
Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give…
Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was…
Who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? Yet he will have rule over all of my labor in which I have labored…
Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.
Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his…
For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can…
Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.
Then I commended mirth, because a man has no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be joyful…
This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all: yes also, the heart of the sons of…
Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever…
I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.
